title: Bihar to dissolve panel, probe land donated under Bhoodan Andolan of Vinoba Bhave

ai.summary: Bihar government plans to dissolve the Bihar Bhoodan Yagya Committee and investigate land donations from Vinoba Bhave's movement, suspecting irregularities in distribution to genuine beneficiaries or public use.

facts.claim: Bihar government plans to dissolve the Bihar Bhoodan Yagya Committee and investigate land donations from Vinoba Bhave's movement
facts.quote: Revenue and land reforms minister Dilip Kumar Jaiswal announced the decision at a press conference here on Wednesday, expressing strong apprehension that “there could be major irregularities” in the way the donated land was distributed over the decades.

facts.claim: suspecting irregularities in distribution to genuine beneficiaries or public use
facts.quote: The government suspects that in many cases the land may not have gone to genuine beneficiaries or for the intended public use.

facts.claim: committee confirmed 3.46 lakh acres from 6.48 lakh acres donated
facts.quote: the committee, which once received nearly 6.48 lakh acres from zamindars and former rulers on Vinoba Bhave’s call, had confirmed only about 3.46 lakh acres.

facts.claim: 2.42 lakh acres distributed to landless and needy families and government purposes
facts.quote: Of this, roughly 2.42 lakh acres were distributed through its district branches to landless and needy families as well as for government purposes.

facts.claim: 6,235 acres remain available for immediate distribution
facts.quote: About 6,235 acres remain available for immediate distribution.

facts.claim: requisitions for 3,310 posts sent to recruitment agency
facts.quote: requisitions for 3,310 posts — 96 assistant settlement officers, 414 kanungos, 2,609 ameens and 191 clerks — have already been sent to the concerned recruitment agency.

facts.claim: another 2,000 vacancies likely to be added, total recruitment closer to 5,000
facts.quote: The minister indicated that another 2,000 vacancies are likely to be added, taking the total recruitment closer to 5,000.

facts.claim: government wants survey completed by January to resolve land disputes
facts.quote: The department hopes to have the newly recruited staff join by January so that fieldwork can pick up pace.

ai.background_note: Bihar government is dissolving the committee overseeing land donations from Vinoba Bhave's movement and conducting an inquiry into land distribution, suspecting irregularities in allocation to genuine beneficiaries or public use.
